summary_en: A quiet Sunday. zengjiajun_eth argued moving Ethereum from EOAs to smart contract accounts is not only a security and UX upgrade but deepens the moat, so EVM forks cannot lure users away at near zero switching cost. MarcoPolo submitted a cell level deltas EIP for data column broadcast.
